x: On the run home round the triangle, the positions remained unchanged and the result was as follows. The handicap resulted in a popular win for Nick Carter, with H.

"Nick" Carter had been entrusted with the first stage, and that our trust was not misplaced was soon evident. Our man was in the first flight right from the stroke of eleven from Big Ben, which started the race.

We also scored further points in this race through Arthur Penny and Frank Webb. In the 2 Miles Team race our three men, Jack Flower, Nick Carter and Alec Robertshaw, finished abreast and so we scored minimum points.

… announced as "Castor and Oil, Continental Tumblers." They looked suspiciously like two Club members, "Nick" Carter and "Paddy" Donnelly—one clad in the height of fashion — plimsolls, football shorts, "dicky," "tails" and "topper"; the other in shorts and a tennis shirt with more rents than Frank We…

At approximately half-way he led "Nick" Carter by 23 sec.—roughly 115 yards—quite a lead to create over a man of Carter's ability. Mains was on Carter's shoulder, then came our "second Footer"—Harry Shields—nearly a minute behind Penny!
